title: Farinata with Rosemary
summary: A rested chickpea-flour batter cooked under a fierce grill in an oiled cast-iron pan with rosemary and black pepper.

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Batter
steps.text: Whisk the chickpea flour and salt in the bowl, then add the water a little at a time, whisking until thin and lump-free.

steps.title: Rest
steps.text: Cover and leave at room temperature 4-8 h so the flour fully hydrates.

steps.title: Heat
steps.text: Put the empty pan on a rack about 15 cm under the grill and heat the oven grill (broiler) on full for 15 min.

steps.title: Pour
steps.text: Skim off any foam from the batter. Carefully take out the pan, add the oil and swirl, then pour in the batter, stir once so the oil streaks through, and scatter with pepper and rosemary.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Grill 11-15 min until set all the way through and blistered with brown freckles.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Rest 10 min in the pan, then slide out and cut into wedges.

tips: The long rest gives a smoother, more tender pancake.
Make sure the pan is very hot before the batter goes in.
storage: Best fresh; keep leftovers covered in the fridge for 1 day and reheat in a hot pan. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
